specific_objectives: 4.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircrafts accident, reporting procedure, crash and salvage duties board of enquiry proceedings, salvage of damaged aircraft and its disposal

intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a Board of Inquiry?
Who constitutes the minimum composition of a BOI?
What is the immediate reporting procedure for an aircraft accident?

development.content:
Composition of Board of Inquiry
Duties and Responsibilities of Board
Reporting Procedure for Accidents
Crash and Salvage Duties
Board of Enquiry Proceedings

Salvage of Damaged Aircraft
Disposal of Aircraft Components
Follow up with Findings
Implementation of Recommendations
Documentation of Salvage Operations

Review of BOI Case Study

Preparation of Follow-up Report
Coordination with Maintenance Units
Final Disposal Authorization

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a Board of Inquiry and a Board of Enquiry.
Describe the steps involved in the follow-up process after BOI recommendations.
What are the key responsibilities of the Board regarding salvage operations?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the reporting procedure for an aircraft accident and how it links to the next lesson on repair and disposal categories.
